desc: CONTROL for 205 round 3, cheapest possible and must run FIRST. Rebuild WITHOUT the copy_highpage WARN (revert the instrument commit), boot maxcpus=2 sdroot.shell, run scripts/t6040-cow-repro.sh up to 4 times in one session. PASS(bug returns) = >=1 kernel trace => the instrumentation really is what suppresses it, and 207's bisect is valid. FAIL(stays clean 4x) = attribution was wrong, the bug is simply intermittent, and EVERY 205 conclusion that relied on single runs must be re-tested with repetition counts. Archive the transcript either way. RESULT 2026-08-03: PASS. Un-instrumented build (t6040-cow string verified absent from the Image) produced 2 kernel traces over 4 reproducer runs at maxcpus=2, vs 0 traces over 4 runs with the instrumentation. Attribution to the instrumentation HOLDS and 207 is valid. Two refinements: (a) the fault fired only in run 1 of 4 => first-touch/settling bias, so a single clean run is WEAK evidence and every future experiment needs >=4 runs with a fresh-boot baseline; (b) the loops completed because the victim was a child, not the parent -- matching the maxcpus=2 "system survives, processes die" behaviour and maxcpus>=3 killing PID 1.
